analysis_python:
"""Summarize paired quality, original evidence, speech, and system resource samples."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import statistics
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.jetson import BASE,HOST,sh

protocol=json.loads(next(Path('bench/results').glob('2026-10-15-dialogue-regression-*-protocol.jsonl')).read_text())
stamp=protocol['stamp']
# Retain remote originals while using the repository's discoverable replay filenames.
for arm in ['baseline','candidate']:
    for family in ['sessions','recall','conversation','conversation-transfer']:
        old=Path(f'bench/results/2026-10-15-dialogue-regression-{arm}-{family}-{stamp}.jsonl')
        target=old.with_name(old.name.replace(f'-{stamp}.jsonl',f'-replay-{stamp}.jsonl'))
        if old.exists():
            assert not target.exists()
            raw=[json.loads(line) for line in old.read_text().splitlines()]
            raw[-1]['source_result']=f'{BASE}/shared/results/{old.name}'
            target.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row)+'\n' for row in raw))
            old.with_suffix('.judged.jsonl').rename(target.with_suffix('.judged.jsonl'))
            old.unlink()
extra_utterances=[]
rows_by_arm={}
records=[]
for arm in ['baseline','candidate']:
    prefix=Path(f'build/dialogue-regression-{arm}-{stamp}')
    samples=[]
    for line in prefix.with_suffix('.vmstat').read_text().splitlines():
        cells=line.split()
        if len(cells)==20 and cells[0].isdigit():
            ts=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(' '.join(cells[-2:])).replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York')).timestamp()
            samples.append((ts,int(cells[6]),int(cells[7])))
    available=[int(line.split()[-1]) for line in prefix.with_suffix('.free').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('Mem:')]
    paging={r['family']:r for r in map(json.loads,prefix.with_suffix('.paging').read_text().splitlines())}
    armrows={}
    for family in ['sessions','recall','conversation','conversation-transfer']:
        result=Path(f'bench/results/2026-10-15-dialogue-regression-{arm}-{family}-replay-{stamp}.jsonl')
        raw=[json.loads(s) for s in result.read_text().splitlines()]
        summary=raw[-1]
        verdicts={r['id']:r for r in map(json.loads,result.with_suffix('.judged.jsonl').read_text().splitlines())}
        assert len(verdicts)==summary['n']==summary['n_expected']
        armrows[family]={r['id']:{**r,'judged':verdicts[r['id']]['pass'],'reason':verdicts[r['id']]['why']} for r in raw[:-1]}
        turns=Path(f'build/dialogue-regression-{arm}-{family}-turns.jsonl')
        sh('rsync','-a',f"{HOST}:{summary['audio_dir']}/turns.jsonl",str(turns))
        logged=[json.loads(s) for s in turns.read_text().splitlines()]
        assert len(logged)==sum(r['split'] for r in raw[:-1]), (arm,family,len(logged))
        scored_wavs={r['wav'] for r in raw[:-1]}
        extra_utterances.extend({'arm':arm,'family':family,'audio_dir':summary['audio_dir'],**r} for r in logged if r['wav'] not in scored_wavs)
        intervals=[(r['speech_start'],max(r['done'],r['first_audio']+r['audio_s'])) for r in logged]
        selected=[(si,so) for ts,si,so in samples[1:] if any(a<ts and b>ts-1 for a,b in intervals)]
        speech=Path(f'build/dialogue-regression-{arm}-{family}-speech.log').read_text()
        match=re.search(r'speech (\d+)/(\d+) match',speech)
        assert match,speech[-300:]
        record={'arm':arm,'family':family,'release':summary['release'],'n':summary['n'],'judged':sum(r['pass'] for r in verdicts.values()),'keyword':summary['correct'],'original_evidence':{'passes':sum(r['original_evidence_ok'] is True for r in raw[:-1]),'n':sum(r['original_evidence_ok'] is not None for r in raw[:-1])},'candidate_evidence':summary['evidence'],'speech':{'passes':int(match[1]),'n':int(match[2])},'synthesized_first_audio_p50_s':summary['first_audio_p50_s'],'detect_fps_p50':summary['detect_fps_p50'],'paging_response_intervals':{'with_paging':sum(si>0 or so>0 for si,so in selected),'n':len(selected),'swap_in_kib':sum(si for si,so in selected),'swap_out_kib':sum(so for si,so in selected)},'whole_run_swap_bytes':{k:(paging[family]['after'][k]-paging[family]['before'][k])*paging[family]['page_bytes'] for k in ('pswpin','pswpout')},'answer_done_p50_s':statistics.median(r['done']-r['speech_end'] for r in logged)}
        record['dialogue_supplied_turns']=[r['id'] for r in raw[:-1] if r.get('exchanges')]
        record['speech_failures']=re.findall(r'^SPEECH ([^:]+):',speech,re.MULTILINE)
        record['split_steps']=[r['id'] for r in raw[:-1] if r['split']!=1]
        records.append(record)
    rows_by_arm[arm]=armrows
    checks=[json.loads(s) for s in prefix.with_suffix('.tokens').read_text().splitlines()] if prefix.with_suffix('.tokens').exists() else []
    resources={'summary':'arm-resources','arm':arm,'minimum_sampled_available_bytes':min(available),'sample_count':len(available),'actual_prompt_token_checks':{'n':len(checks),'maximum':max((r['tokens'] for r in checks),default=None),'all_fit':all(r['fits'] for r in checks) if checks else None},'raw_sources':{f'robot:{BASE}/shared/results/{prefix.name}.{suffix}':hashlib.sha256(prefix.with_suffix('.'+suffix).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for suffix in ['free','vmstat','paging']}}
    records.append(resources)
if extra_utterances:
    from robot.asr import Scribe
    from eval.speech import load_24k,MAX_WER
    from bench.asr_bench import wer
    scribe=Scribe()
    for turn in extra_utterances:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            wave=Path(tmp)/turn['wav']
            sh('rsync','-a',f"{HOST}:{turn['audio_dir']}/{turn['wav']}",str(wave))
            heard=scribe(load_24k(wave))
            error=wer(turn['answer'],heard)
            records.append({'summary':'extra-utterance-speech','arm':turn['arm'],'family':turn['family'],'question':turn['question'],'answer':turn['answer'],'heard':heard,'wer':error,'pass':bool(heard) and error<=MAX_WER,'audio_sha256':hashlib.sha256(wave.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
for family,baseline in rows_by_arm['baseline'].items():
    candidate=rows_by_arm['candidate'][family]
    assert baseline.keys()==candidate.keys()
    differences={}
    for key in ['judged','original_evidence_ok','ok']:
        lost=[ident for ident,r in baseline.items() if r[key] is True and candidate[ident][key] is not True]
        gained=[ident for ident,r in baseline.items() if r[key] is not True and candidate[ident][key] is True]
        differences[key]={'lost':lost,'gained':gained}
    differences['speech']={'new_failures':sorted(set(next(r['speech_failures'] for r in records if r.get('arm')=='candidate' and r.get('family')==family))-set(next(r['speech_failures'] for r in records if r.get('arm')=='baseline' and r.get('family')==family)))}
    records.append({'summary':'paired','family':family,'differences':differences,'changed_answers':[{'id':ident,'baseline':r['answer'],'candidate':candidate[ident]['answer'],'baseline_heard':r['heard'],'candidate_heard':candidate[ident]['heard'],'baseline_judged':r['judged'],'candidate_judged':candidate[ident]['judged'],'candidate_reason':candidate[ident]['reason']} for ident,r in baseline.items() if r['answer']!=candidate[ident]['answer']]})
records.append({'summary':'limits','text':'J measurements on development fixtures only. Oracle input excludes ASR and endpointing. Synthesized first audio excludes physical speaker latency. System paging has one-second interval boundary uncertainty and no process attribution. Samples do not establish peak headroom or sustained safety. Every new judged or original-evidence failure is reported; no deployment or adoption threshold was relaxed. The original Qdrant failure remains open.','analysis_python':Path(__file__).read_text()})
Path(f'bench/results/2026-10-15-dialogue-regression-{stamp}-analysis.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in records))
for r in records:
 if 'changed_answers' in r: r={k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='changed_answers'}
 if 'analysis_python' in r: r={k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='analysis_python'}
 print(json.dumps(r))
